question: Should the heartbeat mismatch be resolved by clarifying the `openclaw status` row source, or by aligning scheduler/default cadence behavior instead?
rationale: Both paths are plausible from the issue: the PR makes the source of the displayed value explicit, while the issue also asks for status to match observed scheduler delivery when defaults diverge.

options.title: Accept label clarification
options.body: Use this PR or a replacement to make the status row explicitly config-derived while leaving scheduler/default behavior unchanged.

options.title: Require cadence alignment
options.body: Reject the label-only fix and instead change the status/scheduler/default path so the displayed cadence matches observed delivery.

options.title: Pause stale branch
options.body: Leave the canonical issue open and close this PR later if contributor proof and a mergeable refresh do not arrive.

recommendation.title: Accept label clarification
recommendation.body: Use this PR or a replacement to make the status row explicitly config-derived while leaving scheduler/default behavior unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The main decision is in the status presentation surface that steipete introduced and recently maintained.
